story-context.title: Component Library Expansion
story-context.overview: Add 2 new components (url, rating) and promote 1 existing-but-unregistered component (paragraph) to full first-class status across all builder layers. Update documentation with a complete component inventory. (file-upload deferred to Story 6.2.2 for full backend infrastructure.)

file.instruction: 1. Add 'url' | 'rating' to the ComponentType union (paragraph already exists). 2. Add url-specific props to ComponentProps: - urlPrefix?: string (default "https://") - urlPattern?: string (custom validation regex) 3. Add rating-specific props to ComponentProps: - ratingMax?: number (5 or 10) - ratingStyle?: 'stars' | 'numbers' | 'emoji' - ratingLabels?: { low?: string; high?: string }
file.current-state: ComponentType union at lines 9-31 includes 'paragraph' but NOT url, rating. (file-upload deferred to Story 6.2.2) ComponentProps at lines 373-471 has date-specific, textarea-specific, dropdown-specific, checkbox/radio-specific, terms-specific, button-specific, address-specific sections. Has [key: string]: unknown catch-all for extensibility.

file.purpose: Component definitions with structure, preview, and runtime renderers
file.instruction:
Add 3 new ComponentDefinition entries following the existing pattern:
1. url — category: 'input', structure: label+input+validation (like email/phone), icon: LinkIcon or GlobeAltIcon, label: "Website URL" 2. rating — category: 'input', structure: label+input+validation, icon: StarIcon, label: "Rating", input object should render star/number rating display 3. paragraph — category: 'display', structure: single content object (like header), icon: DocumentTextIcon or Bars3BottomLeftIcon, label: "Paragraph"
Each needs: - type, label, icon, category - defaultProps with sensible defaults - structure (ComponentStructure) - previewComponent via makeToolboxPreview() - runtimeComponent using UniversalFieldShell + getRenderersForComponent()
file.current-state: Registry at lines 192-877 has 15 entries: first-name, text, number, email, textarea, dropdown, date, checkbox, radio, phone, address, terms, submit-button, header, divider. paragraph is NOT registered despite being in ComponentType union. Pattern: each entry is a ComponentDefinition object in a const array/object.
file.reference-pattern: Header uses category 'display', structure with single content object, customType: 'header', makeToolboxPreview(), and UniversalFieldShell runtime. Paragraph should follow the same pattern with customType: 'paragraph'.

Email uses category 'input', structure with label+input+validation objects, defaultLayout: 'vertical'. URL should follow this pattern closely since it is functionally similar (text input with validation).

implementation-order.step: Add URL, RATING to backend/schemas/form_definition.py ComponentType enum. Run backend tests to verify no regressions.
Add 'url', 'rating' to ComponentType union in builder.types.ts. Add component-specific props to ComponentProps interface.
Add url, rating to input field type check in structureDefaults.ts. Add paragraph to display type check.
Add paragraph ComponentDefinition to ComponentRegistry.tsx following header pattern. This is lowest risk since backend enum and frontend type already exist.
Add url ComponentDefinition following email pattern (label+input+validation). Add URL validation defaults.
Add rating ComponentDefinition with star/number input renderer. Add rating-specific props handling.
Add drag preview cases for url, rating in ComponentPreview.tsx. Verify paragraph case already works.
Add UrlPropertiesSection, RatingPropertiesSection. Verify paragraph exclusions are correct.
Update COMPONENT-FRAMEWORK-GUIDE.md with complete component inventory. Update STORY-6.2-AI-CONTEXT-PACK.md with new component types.
Run npm run lint, npm run test:unit -- --watch=false, python -m pytest --tb=short. Fix any failures. All must pass before UAT.

patterns.pattern: Follow the 'header' component pattern: - category: 'display' - structure: { objects: [{ id: 'content', type: 'content', customType: '...' }] } - No validation object needed - previewComponent: makeToolboxPreview() - runtimeComponent: function using UniversalFieldShell

Follow the DatePropertiesSection pattern: - Create a functional component accepting { component, onUpdate } props - Render form controls that update component.props via onUpdate - Add a case in PropertiesPanel.tsx's type-specific section rendering

pattern.name: Object renderers for new input types

patterns.pattern: The input object renderer in objectRenderers.tsx handles rendering based on component type. For new types, add a case that returns the appropriate JSX: - url: text input with link icon prefix - rating: row of star/number elements

constraints.constraint: Canvas and Runtime must render identically for all new components. Use the surfaceStyles capability to gate builder-only visuals.
Do NOT create a separate 'time' component. The date component already supports dateType: "time" — this should only be documented in the component inventory.
Background images are page-level (FormPage.background), NOT components. Document this in the guide; do not create a background component.

Rating is a UI shell only. Actual rating data persistence is out of scope. The component should render correctly and be configurable in the Properties Panel, but it does not need to submit rating values to a backend.
file-upload is deferred to Story 6.2.2. Do NOT add file-upload type, registry entry, or backend enum value in this story.
All existing tests must continue to pass. No regressions. Frontend baseline: 237 tests, 0 lint errors/warnings. Backend baseline: 512+ tests passing.
Paragraph promotion is purely additive. The type already exists in ComponentType union and backend enum. Only the registry entry, structure defaults, and Properties Panel integration are new.
